worked_solution:
When we divide the two functions, we get a constant, and the limit of a constant is just the constant itself:

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{x\to -\infty }\frac{f(x)}{g(x)} & ={lim}_{x\to -\infty }\frac{9{x}^{6}}{(-4{x}^{6})} \\  & ={lim}_{x\to -\infty }(-\frac{9}{4}) \\  & =-\frac{9}{4}\end{aligned}
$$
